candidate_ledger.output_variable_reasoning: Ra, kt, and k_rms are geometric heights and therefore carry dimension of length (L^1). Sk (skewness), Ku (kurtosis), ES (effective slope), and Po (porosity) are statistical or geometric ratios and are dimensionless (all base exponents zero). Thus ks/Ra is dimensionless if ks has the same length dimension as Ra; the listed inputs supply one independent dimension (L) only, so dimensionless combinations must cancel L. This ledger encodes the SI exponents for use in Buckingham-π analysis.
